Mukundara Hills Tiger Reserve Resource Archive

A locally archived research library for Mukundara Hills Tiger Reserve: official notifications, conservation plans, ESZ records, clearance files, biodiversity references, and live public datasets.

We preserve local PDF copies because government and institutional links can move, fail, or disappear. The original source link is still shown on every document page for citation and version checking.

Archived documents

These documents were downloaded and stored locally on May 21, 2026. Each document has a detail page with summary, source, archive metadata, suggested use, and an embedded PDF viewer.

Live portals and context links

These links are useful but are not locally archived as PDFs. Some are live datasets, portal pages, or context links that are better opened at the source.

  • Mukundara Hills Tiger Reserve - Rajasthan Forest Department

    Type: Official state portal • Source: Rajasthan Forest Department

    Use this for: Baseline official profile, administrative framing, and entry-point information.

    Note: Live portal page; details can change without notice.

  • MEE-TR Geospatial Portal - Mukundara Hills Tiger Reserve

    Type: Geospatial portal / GIS reference • Source: Wildlife Institute of India (WII)

    Use this for: Boundary context, landscape orientation, and broad planning visualization.

    Note: Use for orientation only; do not republish sensitive wildlife-use locations.

  • eBird hotspot - Mukundara Hills

    Type: Citizen-science dataset • Source: eBird / Cornell Lab

    Use this for: Seasonality, checklist frequency, and birding effort trends over time.

    Note: Interpret with observer bias and uneven sampling effort in mind.

  • Biodiversity of MHTR - iNaturalist project

    Type: Citizen-science dataset • Source: iNaturalist / Sonu Kumar

    Use this for: Recent community observations, live species context, and public field documentation.

    Note: This complements the curated list on the biodiversity page.

  • Phytodiversity Characterization of Mukundara Hills Tiger Reserve

    Type: ResearchGate landing page • Source: ResearchGate mirror

    Use this for: Citation traceability and alternate access to the plant diversity paper.

    Note: The locally archived IJCMA PDF appears to cover the same research article.

  • Mukundara Hills is Rajasthan's third tiger reserve

    Type: News archive • Source: The Hindu

    Use this for: Historical context during designation and early public communication.

    Note: Use primary documents for legal or technical conclusions.

How to use this library effectively

  • For legal status: start with notification, ESZ, ZMP, and clearance documents.
  • For management direction: read the Tiger Conservation Plan and NTCA sanction/APO documents.
  • For ecological understanding: combine field guides, peer-reviewed studies, and seasonal datasets.
  • For maps: use geospatial tools for orientation, never for sharing sensitive wildlife coordinates.

Suggest a source or correction

If you have a primary document, peer-reviewed study, or reliable dataset relevant to Mukundara Hills Tiger Reserve, send it for review. We prioritize source quality, citation traceability, and conservation-safe publishing.
